files.description: Streaming subscribers, one per row (320 rows): subscriber_id (whole number), age (years, from 19 to 87; about 1% empty), tier (basic, plus or premium; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), monthly_fee (two decimals; about 3% empty), joined_year (whole number).

task_text: Group the subscribers by the five-year period in which they joined (2015-2019, 2020-2024, 2025-2029; a period is identified by its first year) and give the mean monthly fee per period, rounded to two decimals. `result` should be a table with the columns period_start and mean_fee.
intended_computation: Map joined_year to the first year of its five-year period (2015, 2020 or 2025) and return period_start with the mean monthly_fee (missing fees skipped) rounded to 2 decimals; 3 periods.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the computed period key is dropped from the column-style group output; 3.x keeps it

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
